import 'package:hazard_fixture/scales.dart';
import 'package:test/test.dart';

void main() {
  test('lookup', () {
    expect(lookup(0), 1);
    expect(lookup(4), 40);
    expect(lookup(9), -1);
  });

  test('lookup below', () => expect(lookup(-1), -1));

  test('rates', () {
    expect(Rates.of('low'), 6);
    expect(Rates.of('high'), 20);
    expect(Rates.of('none'), 0);
  });

  // Declared from the code under test: a mutant can change how many there
  // are, and it is at work while they are declared.
  final declared = cases();
  for (final value in declared) {
    test('half of $value', () => expect(half(value), value ~/ 2));
  }
  test('three cases', () => expect(declared, hasLength(3)));
}
